lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: Little Hill Village. Today is {hero}'s birthday.

lines.speaker: granny_bai
lines.en: Happy birthday, {hero}! I found this by the old well this morning. It's warm... and it's wiggling.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: Crack... crack... POP! A tiny golden dragon tumbles out of the egg.

lines.speaker: granny_bai
lines.en: A golden dragon! I haven't seen one of those since... well. Since I was young and brave and had knees that worked.

lines.speaker: granny_bai
lines.en: One word is all he knows. Words are precious, little one. Lately the creatures out in the meadow have been forgetting theirs.

lines.speaker: granny_bai
lines.en: A grey fog rolled over the hills. Now the rabbits are grumpy and the crows won't stop shouting.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.en: What should I say to the little dragon?

lines.speaker: xiaolong
lines.en: (He spins in a circle and hugs your leg.)

lines.speaker: xiaolong
lines.en: (He tilts his head, waiting... then hugs your leg anyway.)

lines.speaker: granny_bai
lines.en: When someone gives you a present, we say {C007}. Go on, try it!

lines.speaker: granny_bai
lines.en: Ha! Good manners. He looks like a Xiaolong to me. Little Dragon. Now take my old stick... and this hungry fellow.

lines.speaker: xiaolong
lines.en: (He chews the stick. Then he chews your sleeve.)

lines.speaker: granny_bai
lines.en: Farmer Li down the road needs help. Talk kindly, answer bravely, and the fog will clear. Off you go!
